newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index inches up in week.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index inches up in week.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index inched up 2.9 points or 0.10 percent last week. The All Ordinaries Index fell 1.67 percent.
Aug 15 Aug 8 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The index struggled into positive territory after a shaky start to the week, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in the weekly Eyres Reed index report.
"A strong bounce in the gold sector, despite a range-bound bullion price, helped buoy some smaller issues by week's end," he said.
The best performers were Intermin Resource Corp, up two cents to 16 cents, Leo Shield Exploration NL rose three to 18.5 cents and Golden Valley Mines rose seven cents to 38 cents.
Frontier Petroleum rose 2.5 cents to 9.5 cents rose 2.5 cents to 9.5 cents after the settlement of its dispute with Anzoil.
Falling stocks included Victoria Petroleum, after its Daisy-1 well in the United States was plugged and abandoned.
